facts.value: Application deadlines are set and managed by individual degree programs. Visit the program website to review the deadlines for your proposed admission term.
You will not receive an application fee refund if your application is not complete by the deadline.
The application requires your cumulative undergraduate GPA, junior-senior GPA and graduate GPA (if applicable).
Junior-senior GPA refers to the last two years or 60 semester credit hours of your undergraduate work.
The academic program may or may not require supplemental documents such as letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, resume, portfolio or test scores (GRE, GMAT, MAT).
ASU Degree Search website provides admission requirements for graduate degree programs.
The department's website contains information about degrees, events, contact information, faculty, curriculum and more.
The admission application will provide deeper insights into a program’s admission requirements.
General application advice is available at the Graduate Information Session and Application Advice webinar.
The application must be completed and the application fee must be paid before ASU emails the recommenders.
You have access to resend the email to your recommender every seven days through My ASU.
If your recommender does not seem to be receiving the emails, please have them check their email spam or junk folder.
Contact the academic program office offering the program to discuss deadlines and exceptions.
